description:
## Problem

The `GET /api/v1/brands/generate/options` endpoint hardcodes `available: false` for Ollama and OpenRouter integrations instead of checking the actual configuration. Users always see "Not configured" in the UI even when providers are properly set up via environment variables.

## Root Cause

In `handlers/generate.go` (or `scanner_plugin.go`), the `GenerateOptions` handler returns a static list of providers with `available: false` for all except "Manual Entry". It should check:
- `h.cfg.OllamaURL != ""` → Ollama available
- `h.cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey != ""` → OpenRouter available

The actual AI generation endpoints (`POST /api/v1/brands/{id}/generate`) correctly detect provider availability at request time via `h.aiChain()`, so the fix is just aligning the options endpoint with the same config checks.

## Expected Fix

1. Update `GenerateOptions` handler to read `h.cfg.OllamaURL` and `h.cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey`
2. Set `available: true` for providers whose config is present
3. Optionally do a lightweight health check (e.g., Ollama `/api/tags` endpoint) to confirm reachability, with a short timeout so the UI doesn't hang
4. Add tests covering: both configured, one configured, neither configured

## Key Files

- Handler: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/handlers/generate.go` (GenerateOptions function)
- Config: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/config/config.go` (OllamaURL, OpenRouterAPIKey fields)
- AI chain: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/aigen/provider.go` (provider detection pattern)
- UI component: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/components/generate-options.tsx` (renders the status)
name: brand-manager-integration-status
title: Fix GenerateOptions Endpoint to Report Actual Integration Availability
